summaries.en: Mount Project Membership HTTP in the production Platform image so Cloud Projects can create, invite, and heartbeat against gestaltrun.com.
summaries.zh: 生产 Platform 镜像挂载 Project Membership HTTP，使 Cloud Project 的创建、邀请和心跳可走 gestaltrun.com。
